base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

protocol.changed_rule: replace active rollout objective by first-frame area plus two paid successor areas plus a common-arrival fluid tail
protocol.arrival_path: class i arrivals at (n-0.5)/lambda_i for n>=1 through common H; zero-rate classes have no arrivals; one path shared by both contenders
protocol.horizon_rule: H=3*maximum effective catalogue duration covers both first-frame-plus-two-successor paths; all arrivals through H are included and eventually cleared
protocol.batch_area: unserved visible jobs times frame duration plus actual completion offsets plus each within-frame arrival's barrier wait; new arrivals become dispatchable at the next boundary
protocol.successor: two integer feasible frames per contender; same q_i/mu_i class priority, largest fitting measured pure batch and maximal homogeneous lane copies as frozen batch rollout; idle also costs one attempt
protocol.tail: from each path's last boundary, integrate nonnegative fluid queues at the frozen per-class mu through remaining shared arrivals to H, then stop arrivals and clear; no extra frame construction
protocol.objective: complete holding area on this deterministic common population; old Poisson current/terminal formulas remain challenger diagnostics only and are not added to the path objective
protocol.current_search: unchanged recycled rollout frontier, K-4 reservation when seeds plus four fit, two old analytic contenders, seed and 1% floor, unused-reserve recovery and support fallback
protocol.costs: charge current plus successor attempts<=K; separately count path generation and arrival reads, queue updates, fluid integration, candidate pricing and completion reads
protocol.known_counterexample: describe new prediction and action at the previously observed (1,4,8), without requiring it to improve or using a future tape
protocol.zero_arrivals: path area mathematically reduces to the previous batch objective when all lambda are zero
protocol.controls: full-K v4, full-K analytic lookahead, and frozen recycled rollout; reproduce 108 controls from the preceding development artifact
protocol.reference: v4 K120 remains the exact support reference
protocol.stopping_rule: all 144 cases once; no changing arrival phase, horizon, terminal rule or budget allocation after outcomes

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

limitations: The common midpoint rate path is deterministic, omits Poisson fluctuations and may align with batch thresholds; its cost is not an expected Poisson value.
Only two successor frames per contender are discrete; the remaining continuation is a fixed-rate fluid approximation and only the original analytic challenger can compete.
These are reused development seeds; comparisons and shared-worker wall times are descriptive rather than independent confirmation.
